He stood quiet as the gale rattled the lighthouse lens, tucking the note into his woolen coat, finally hearing a voice he had only ever known from old family stories.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市褪去白日的喧嚣，柏油路面还留着日间阳光烘烤后的微温，沿街路灯晕着暖黄光团，把梧桐的影子拉得纤长。偶尔有晚归代驾骑着电动车掠过，轮胎碾过路面发出细碎声响，24小时便利店的玻璃门透出冷白光，值夜店员趴在台面打盹，远处楼宇零星亮着几盏灯，每盏灯后都藏着一个未眠的人，整座城市正伴着微风轻缓呼吸。", "w03": "- Recursion means solving a big, tricky problem by breaking it into tiny, identical, smaller versions of that same problem.\n- Think of counting how many blocks are stacked in a tower: you count one block on top plus all the blocks in the shorter tower below it, until you reach the very bottom block with nothing under it.\n- You always need a clear stopping point so you don’t keep breaking the problem smaller forever until you get too dizzy to keep going."}
